title: rich tool titles and visible Thinking on the ACP wire
intent: Paseo collapsed tool calls looked uniform because Yeah sent only the tool name as title, although rawInput was present. The provider now derives a bounded human title from declared input: Bash shows the command, Read and edit show the path, Grep and Glob show the pattern, and Emacs/Git capabilities show the buffer, symbol or directory. Reasoning was another display gap: gptel delivered reasoning chunks, but Yeah dropped them. The turn now writes a bounded reasoning journal record and ACP projects it as agent_thought_chunk, which Paseo renders as Thinking.
checks: cd plugin/yeah-provider && npm run typecheck && npm test
objection: A rich title is a projection, not additional execution data; rawInput remains the source of exact arguments. A reasoning chunk may be provider-specific: if gptel or the model sends none, there is nothing to show. The journal record is bounded and is not a prompt to continue reasoning as an answer.
refuted_by: Paseo receives a known tool call whose collapsed title is only the tool name, a reasoning callback is absent from the journal, the wire sends reasoning as an agent message, or a reasoning callback completes the run
